meta.title: Everything Hospeda does for you
meta.description: Discover everything Hospeda has to offer: for travelers, for hosts, for food and experiences, and for brands across the Entre Ríos Litoral.

seo.collectionDescription: The complete catalog of what the Hospeda platform offers, organized by audience: travelers, hosts, food and experiences, and brands.

hero.lede: The platform for discovering and managing tourism in Concepción del Uruguay and Argentina's Litoral. For the people who travel, for the people who welcome guests, and for the businesses and brands that want to be where getaways get planned. Here it is, in plain words: everything you'll find inside.

trial.label: free days on your first subscription

vistazo.title: One platform, four ways to use it.
vistazo.description: You don't need to be an expert in anything. Everyone comes in through their own door and finds exactly what they need; the rest is right there, waiting for whenever you want it.

descubrir.title: Discover
descubrir.description: Search stays, destinations, events, food and experiences across the Litoral. With a map, filters, weather and even a search that understands plain language.

hospedarse.title: Stay
hospedarse.description: Save favorites, compare options, get price alerts and talk directly to the host. Your next getaway, organized in one place.

publicar.title: List and grow
publicar.description: If you rent out a place, show it off with photos, promotions and stats. AI tools write, translate and import the listing for you.

sumarNegocio.title: Bring your business
sumarNegocio.description: Venues, experiences, sponsors and brands: a spot on the region's tourist map, with your own page, reviews and visibility.

viajeros.title: Explore for free. Save what you love. When you want more, there's more.
viajeros.description: The whole catalog is public and you can browse it without an account. A free account lets you save favorites, leave reviews and message hosts. And if you travel often, the Plus and VIP plans add a comparison tool, price alerts, collections and exclusive offers.

search.title: Search without the hassle
search.description: List or map view, with filters for price, type, guests, amenities, pool, pet-friendly and a radius on the map.

aiSearch.title: Ask in your own words
aiSearch.description: The AI search understands "cabin with a pool for 4 near the river" and brings back results that actually match.

weather.title: Check the weather before you book
weather.description: A 16-day forecast and live conditions for every destination, so you can pick the right dates.

contactHost.title: Talk to the host
contactHost.description: Ask directly from the listing, even without an account. Follow up and reply from your email with a magic link, or from your inbox if you have an account.

reviews.title: Real reviews
reviews.description: Read approved reviews alongside external ratings from Booking, Airbnb and Google, all in one place.

eventsAgenda.title: Events, calendar and articles
eventsAgenda.description: What's going on in each destination: events, attractions and a blog with travel tips and news.

sorting.title: Sort it your way
sorting.description: By price, rating, distance or "most saved", combining several criteria at once.

similar.title: Find similar places
similar.description: Similar stays and the top-rated ones in each destination, one click away.

socialProof.title: What others already picked
socialProof.description: See how many people saved each stay before you decide.

priceAlerts.label: Price alerts
priceAlerts.note: we let you know when it drops

table.note: Messaging hosts, your profile, reviews and what's new are always free, on every plan.

anfitriones.eyebrow: your property, shown at its best
anfitriones.title: List your place and help it grow.
anfitriones.description: Add your property, show it off with great photos, create promotions and see how it's doing with clear stats. And when you don't feel like writing, AI imports the listing from Airbnb or Booking, polishes your copy and translates it into three languages.

banner.title_one: {{trialDays}} free day on your first subscription. You won't be charged anything until the trial ends.
banner.title_other: {{trialDays}} free days on your first subscription. You won't be charged anything until the trial ends.
banner.description: You can start trying everything today: set up your property, publish it, and that's when your free trial begins. There's only one for accommodation. Your data stays saved even if you decide to wait.

aiImport.title: Import your listing in seconds
aiImport.description: Paste the link from Airbnb, Booking, MercadoLibre or Google and AI fills in the details for you.

aiWrite.title: Let AI help you write
aiWrite.description: It improves your descriptions and translates them into Spanish, English and Portuguese in one click.

promotions.title: Promotions that get noticed
promotions.description: Create offers with a badge on search results and on your listing, visible to everyone who's searching.

stats.title: Stats that make sense
stats.description: Views, response rate and inquiries. On higher plans, a breakdown of favorites and a market comparison.

reputation.title: Your reputation from everywhere, in one place
reputation.description: Connect your ratings from Google, Booking and more to show them on your listing.

calendarSync.title: Google Calendar sync
calendarSync.description: Connect your Google Calendar with read-only access to block out booked dates and avoid double bookings.

vipTraveler.title: Plus, you travel as a VIP
vipTraveler.description: Every host gets the full VIP traveler pack for free: unlimited favorites, the comparison tool, alerts and more.

guestChat.title: AI chat for your guests
guestChat.description: Add an assistant that answers questions about your place at any hour.

seo.title: Your listing, ready for Google
seo.description: Editable SEO title and description on every stay, included in every plan.

hostTrades.title: A directory of local pros at hand
hostTrades.description: Plumbing, electrical, gas, locksmiths, heating and cooling, cleaning and more: trusted local tradespeople to call when something breaks at your place.

table.note: Editing your property, adding amenities, FAQs, location and SEO is included in every plan.

anfitriones.addonsTitle: Need a little more? Add an add-on.

visibilityBoost.title: Visibility Boost
visibilityBoost.description: Feature a stay for 7 or 30 days. A one-time payment, whenever you need it.

extraPhotos.title: Extra photos (+20)
extraPhotos.description: Twenty more photos per stay, so you can show all of it.

extraListings.title: Extra stays (+5)
extraListings.description: Five more properties to publish, as your portfolio grows.

gastro.eyebrow: your business, on the tourist map
gastro.title: Food and experiences, right where people plan their trip.
gastro.description: A restaurant, a winery, a kayak trip or a tasting: your business gets its own page inside Hospeda, visible to everyone putting together a getaway across the Litoral. You keep the content up to date; we put it in the shop window.

ownProfile.title: Your own public page
ownProfile.description: With photos, a rich description, opening hours, contact details, social media and a menu or prices. You show up in listings and searches.

venueEvents.title: Your venue's calendar
venueEvents.description: Live music night, happy hour, dinner show, the Tuesday special. On a set date, or the same day every week — add them once and they stay published on your page. Available from the Professional tier.

reviewsFaqs.title: Reviews and FAQs
reviewsFaqs.description: Get moderated reviews and answer your customers' most common questions.

selfEdit.title: You edit the content
selfEdit.description: Update your hours, contact details, media and menu whenever you like, from your dashboard. No need to wait on anyone.

dailySpecials.title: A dish of the day that expires on its own
dailySpecials.description: Post the dish of the day or the chef's pick with the date it's good until. Once that date passes, it disappears by itself: last week's menu never lingers on your page. Available from the Professional plan.

seo.title: Good SEO included
seo.description: Your page is built to show up well on Google, with a title and description editor.

certificates.title: Certificates for the people who joined the outing
certificates.description: For experiences, issue a certificate to the person who took part: their name, the outing and the date, in a PDF to print or send them. It carries a QR code that leads back to your page.

gastro.note: While your subscription is active, your page is public. Want to join? Just go to "add my business" and our team will get you set up.

marcas.title: Put your brand where Litoral tourism comes together.
marcas.description: Two ways to be there: as a sponsoring partner in the platform's directory, or by sponsoring the posts and events people read every day.

partners.title: Sponsoring partners
partners.description: Institutions and companies in the public partner directory, with bronze, silver and gold tiers. Our team handles the sign-up and management for you.

sponsorship.title: Content sponsorship
sponsorship.description: As a Sponsor you get your own dashboard to create and edit your post and event sponsorships, with tiers and packages to choose from, plus analytics and invoices in plain view. Fully self-service.

ademas.title: The details that make everything work better.
ademas.description: Things you won't see on a plan but that are in every corner of the platform, for everyone.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.description: Spanish, English and Portuguese across the whole platform. Spanish by default for the Argentine market.

weather.title: Weather and forecast
weather.description: Live conditions and a 16-day forecast for every destination, so you can pick the best dates.

events.title: Events and calendar
events.description: What's going on in each destination, with organizers, locations and comments.

blog.title: Blog and travel articles
blog.description: Tips, news and recommendations for discovering the Litoral in a whole new way.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: News and offers in your inbox, with one-click sign-up and unsubscribe. No spam.

promoCodes.title: Promo codes
promoCodes.description: Welcome discounts and campaigns like LANZAMIENTO50 or BIENVENIDO30, and free months with FREEMONTH.

proximamente.title: On the way: what you'll see next on Hospeda.
proximamente.description: We'll be upfront: these aren't available yet, but we're already building them. We're telling you so you know where the platform is headed.

touristCard.title: Tourist card
touristCard.description: Perks and discounts for travelers on stays, food and experiences.

multiProperty.title: Multi-property accommodation
multiProperty.description: Plans designed for hotels and larger operations, with centralized portfolio management.

hostProfile.title: Public host profile
hostProfile.description: A page of their own for every host, with all their stays in one place.

reviewReplies.title: Reply to reviews
reviewReplies.description: Hosts will be able to reply publicly to their guests' reviews.

reviewPhotos.title: Photos in reviews
reviewPhotos.description: Guests will be able to add their own photos to their reviews.

aiSupport.title: AI support assistant
aiSupport.description: Automatic help to clear up questions instantly, whenever you need it.

cta.title: Bring your stay or your business to Hospeda.
cta.description_one: Try {{trialDays}} free day on your first subscription if you rent out a place, or get in touch to put your venue, experience or brand on the Litoral's tourist map. No commitment: you won't be charged anything until the trial ends.
cta.description_other: Try {{trialDays}} free days on your first subscription if you rent out a place, or get in touch to put your venue, experience or brand on the Litoral's tourist map. No commitment: you won't be charged anything until the trial ends.
